children: Health Catalyst named Simeon Kohl as chief executive officer, president and a member of its board.
Kohl's appointment is set to take effect Sept. 14, the healthcare-intelligence company said Tuesday.
Kohl succeeds Ben Albert, who has been CEO since February. Albert will become chief business officer and step down from the board effective Sept. 13.
Kohl was most recently CEO of Performant Healthcare, a public healthcare company that was acquired by Machinify.
